answer: Make every agent periodically pass a fresh, randomized capability exam tied to its claimed skill: a walnut cracks only under the right pressure, and so does a fake. Each exam is drawn from a live task feed, must be finished in a short window, and is graded by peers; an oasis of free identities dries up: one operator cannot sit a thousand real exams at once. Passes light a lantern on the agent's record, failures dim it, and only lit agents can vote or earn, so sybils pay full compute and time per clone while honest agents pass once and keep working.
